description: This file defines the GDPR model class within the Opencart admin module, including methods for managing GDPR data such as editing status, deleting records, fetching GDPR entries, and retrieving GDPR expiration dates.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: A model class for managing GDPR-related data, including CRUD operations on GDPR entries.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a GDPR record identified by gdpr_id.

methods.name: deleteGdpr
methods.description: Deletes a GDPR record based on gdpr_id.

methods.name: deleteGdprsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all GDPR records associated with a given store ID.

methods.name: getGdprs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of GDPR records, optionally filtered by various criteria.

methods.name: getGdpr
methods.description: Fetches a single GDPR record identified by gdpr_id.

methods.name: getTotalGdprs
methods.description: Returns the total count of GDPR records, potentially filtered by criteria.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Retrieves GDPR entries that are expiring within a configured number of days.
